items.name: hall_s1
items.text: Inside a grand ancient stone hall: a soft breeze blowing through a wide open doorway, silk banners rustling faintly, the distant murmur of people outside echoing softly. Gentle, even and continuous from start to finish. No footsteps, no clear words, no music.

items.name: hall_s3
items.text: Quiet ambience inside a large palace hall with high wooden beams: soft echoing air, a faint distant murmur of a crowd and the occasional soft rustle of silk robes, gentle reverb. Even and continuous from start to finish. No bells, no footsteps, no clear words, no music.
